notes: The piezo is modelled with the catalogue 'buzzer' type (piezo disc, ports 1 and 2). Port 1 is taken as the black (lower voltage) lead, in breadboard column 5 and tied to GND. Port 2 is the red lead, in column 8 and tied to A0.
The image shows the upper half of the breadboard labelled rows j to f. That is the catalogue's bank 'b' (rows f-j), so the holes are written as 5b.x and 8b.x.
Piezo legs are in 5b.i and 8b.i. The 1 Megohm resistor spans 5b.h to 8b.h, in parallel with the piezo. The black jumper goes to 5b.g and the red jumper to 8b.f.
The black wire goes to the Uno GND pin beside pin 13. I assigned it to GND.1; the catalogue does not say which GND header pin that is.
The schematic shows 5V at the top of the Uno, but nothing is connected to it.
Resistor value is written in ohms (1000000 = 1 Megohm).
